sources.contexts: PubMed E-utilities, Humans[MeSH] context sets (harvested 2026-10-22); ductal and acinar sets without tumor names and retracted publications removed (2026-11-20)
sources.geneSets: H: MSigDB 2026.2.Hs; PROGENY: saezlab/progeny @ cad6be0514c3 (v1.17.3); REACTOME: MSigDB 2026.2.Hs; WIKIPATHWAYS: MSigDB 2026.2.Hs; GOBP: MSigDB 2026.2.Hs
sources.displayedGenes: PDAC demo site: markerInfo, typeExpression, comparison table and gene-set top genes

method.paper: PubMed record indexed Humans[MeSH] that matches the human pancreas query and is annotated by PubTator3 with the human gene (NCBI Gene ID)
method.scope: human pancreatic tumor papers: human pancreas papers indexed with the MeSH headings Pancreatic Neoplasms or Carcinoma, Pancreatic Ductal (all human pancreas papers minus those left after excluding them); this includes neuroendocrine and cystic tumors of the pancreas
method.cellTypePaper: scope paper that also matches the PubMed query of the cell type (MeSH and title/abstract terms): a co-mention of the gene and the cell type in one paper, not a statement about the gene in that cell type; for ductal and acinar cells tumor names (ductal adenocarcinoma, acinar cell carcinoma) do not count
method.expected: scope papers x cellTypeShare; cellTypeShare = share of gene-annotated scope papers that match the cell-type query
method.enrichment: (observed + 0.5) / (expected + 0.5); expected and enrichment rounded to 3 decimals
method.union: a gene set is counted on the union of its member genes' papers, each paper once
method.recent: newest publication year first, then higher PMID
method.caution: Counts measure research attention. Gene annotations are automatic and gene names can be ambiguous; a paper that mentions a gene and a cell type is not evidence that the gene acts in that cell type.

markRules.family: at least 50% of at least 5 papers name only a family, complex or generic term
markRules.unsure: at least 50% of at least 5 papers use an abbreviation with more than one meaning
markRules.full text only: fewer than 6% of at least 30 papers name the gene in title, abstract or keywords

ductal.query: ("ductal cell"[tiab] OR "ductal cells"[tiab] OR "duct cell"[tiab] OR "duct cells"[tiab] OR "ductal epithelial"[tiab] OR "ductal epithelium"[tiab] OR "ductal epithelia"[tiab] OR "duct epithelial"[tiab] OR "duct epithelium"[tiab] OR "duct epithelia"[tiab])
ductal.rule: a match outside a tumor name is required

acinar.rule: records with acinar only inside a tumor name and without the MeSH heading Acinar Cells are left out

corrections.rule: A gene-paper link is not counted when the gene was recognized in the paper only by strings that denote something else (an abbreviation of a drug, disease, cell type or method, or another gene). Genes whose papers mostly name a family or an ambiguous abbreviation, or name the gene only in the full text, are marked and left out of the rankings.

fields.cellTypes: order of all per-cell-type arrays in this file
fields.sets: gene-set id (as in pdac-genesets.json) -> [libraryGenes, genesWithScopePapers, scopePapers, observed, expected, enrichment, topCellType]
fields.libraryGenes: member genes of the set in the gene-set library
fields.genesWithScopePapers: member genes with at least 1 scope paper
fields.scopePapers: scope papers annotated with at least one member gene (union, each paper once)
fields.observed: array, one value per cell type: those papers that match the cell-type query
fields.expected: array, one value per cell type: scopePapers x cellTypeShare
fields.enrichment: array, one value per cell type: (observed + 0.5) / (expected + 0.5)
fields.topCellType: cell type with the highest enrichment among cell types with at least 3 observed papers; null when none
fields.activityAgreement: gene sets with a top cell type and a cell type of highest activity (pdac-genesets.json, best), and how many name the same cell type
